description: This file defines a React functional component 'TagFilter' that provides a dropdown UI for filtering and selecting tags. It manages its internal state for dropdown open/close, search term input, and interacts with external props for available and selected tags. The component includes event handling for outside clicks, keyboard interactions, and tag selection/removal.

methods.name: TagFilter
methods.description: React functional component rendering a filter dropdown for tags, with search, select, and remove functionalities.
